seo.title: Careers at Buzznerd | Join the Team
seo.description: We're always looking for talented, tech-driven nerds to join the team. Contact us to learn what working at Buzznerd is like and to inquire about open positions.

sections.headline: Come be a nerd
sections.subheadline: We're always looking for talented, tech-driven nerds to join the team. Contact us to learn more about what working at Buzznerd is like — and to inquire about any open positions.

sections.title: What it's like to work here

items.title: Work on real AI
items.body: Ship products that power 700+ dealership rooftops — not slideware.

items.title: Seattle roots, remote-friendly
items.body: A small, senior team that answers the phone and sweats the details.

items.title: Room to grow
items.body: Wear many hats, own your work, and grow as fast as you can learn.

sections.title: No open-role requirement
sections.body: If you're a great nerd, we want to hear from you. Reach out and tell us what you're interested in — we'll review and get back to you within one business day.

sections.title: Think you'd be a great nerd?
sections.body: Tell us what you're interested in and inquire about open positions. We'll get back to you within one business day.
